title: GTA 6 PS5 Pro Features Revealed, 30fps Target on Both Consoles
summary: Improved clarity and ray traced shadows on PS5 Pro
text: GTA 6 PS5 Pro Features Revealed, 30fps Target on Both Consoles | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 Grand Theft Auto GTA GTA 6 PS5 Pro Features Revealed, 30fps Target on Both Consoles Improved clarity and ray traced shadows on PS5 Pro by Liam Croft 7 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games has today revealed what sort of benefits playing GTA 6 on a PS5 Pro will provide. No matter whether you play on a base PS5 or a PS5 Pro, though, the game will target 30 frames-per-second, a new post on the developer's website confirms: Grand Theft Auto VI has been fully developed from the ground up to provide the best possible experience for the current generation of consoles, targeting 30 frames per second while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits to bring the vast and rich world of Leonida to life — while maintaining the density and visual fidelity of all its environments and inhabitants. The improvements are slim on PS5 Pro; the article mentions "improved clarity" thanks to PSSR, and there'll be ray traced shadows that are only available on the upgraded console. There is no 60fps mode, or even a 40fps mode for GTA 6. This also applies to the Xbox Series X|S versions. Related Articles Guide GTA 6 Release Times and Preload: When Can You Start Playing? All the GTA 6 release info you need The blog post then talks up the game's use of the PS5 DualSense controller, making use of haptic feedback, far better audio, and improved load times. It concludes by calling PS5 the best place to play GTA 6. As of today, the game is available to preload worldwide on PS5 ahead of the full 19th November launch. Please refer to our GTA 6 Release Times and Preload guide for more information. How do you feel about there being no 40fps or 60fps performance modes in GTA 6? Let us know in the comments below.
